title: install-sprint-42-customer-handovers-and-blockers-jun-2026
content:
Sprint 42 — Customer handovers, install progress, and active blockers

Date: 2026-06-15
Attendees: Maya Chen (owner), Rohit Patel, Lina Gómez, Ethan Park, Tom Brewer (SE on GreenBank), Priya Nair (Customer Success)
Meeting type: weekly standup + install sync (private deployments)

TL;DR:
- Two on-prem installs completed (Acme Health staging, RetailCo pilot). GreenBank VPC install still blocked by network egress policy and MTU mismatch.
- Installer 2.3.4 RC showed kernel mismatch warnings on RHEL8; created PR to surface warnings earlier.
- Action items assigned for triage of customer telemetry gaps and improved preflight checks.

Progress summary
- Acme Health (staging): installer run successful, pod readiness reached 100% after kubelet restart. Post-install smoke test passed for text-gen endpoint. Follow-up: SOC requested encrypted audit logs; roadmap item to ship S3-compatible log forwarder.
- RetailCo (pilot): on-prem cluster configured, hotfix applied for GPU driver 535 compatibility. Batch inference throughput tests at 85% of expected — identified a small batching configuration mismatch (batcher.max_tokens). Scheduled tuning next week.
- GreenBank (prod VPC): install fails at network egress validation. Customer NAT gateway strips source ports causing session churn; control-plane to data-plane websocket handshakes failing intermittently.

Active blockers (prioritized)
1) GreenBank network egress and MTU issues (severity: P0)
   - Symptom: control-plane websocket connections to onprem-agent drop after ~60s; installer reports 502 during rollout.
   - Investigation: packet captures show MTU of 1400 on customer side, fragmenting long TLS records; also NAT gateway port translation reassignments cause client sockets to appear as new flows.
   - Owner: Rohit Patel
   - Next steps: (a) propose installer change to use smaller TLS record sizes / enable TLS_MAX_FRAGMENT workaround in agent (PR draft: github.com/redwood-inference/private-installer/pull/128), (b) SE to request customer networking to raise MTU or add path MTU discovery exceptions, (c) add a preflight check to detect NAT port churn patterns.
   - ETA: blockers triage meeting 2026-06-16; hotfix target 2026-06-18 if customer allows agent restart.

2) Installer warning -> RHEL8 kernel ABI mismatch (severity: P1)
   - Symptom: installer logs contain unknown syscall fallback messages; non-fatal but noisy.
   - Owner: Ethan Park
   - Next steps: push change to installer to detect kernel version earlier and present clearer remediation steps (backport notes to docs). PR assigned: CONFLUENCE-Private-Deploy-Runbook link updated.

3) Telemetry missing for RetailCo after driver hotfix (severity: P2)
   - Symptom: agent metrics stopped reporting GPU utilization for 3 hours post-upgrade.
   - Owner: Lina Gómez
   - Investigation: logs show nvidia-smi intermittent permission errors when daemonset restarted under restricted file permissions.
   - Next steps: adjust daemonset securityContext so device plugin can open /dev/nvidia* with root group; file a follow-up runbook entry.

Decisions made
- We will ship a conservative change to the agent that reduces TLS record size by default in environments with observed MTU < 1500. Rationale: minimal customer impact and fast mitigation.
- Add a new preflight check to the installer for NAT port-reuse signatures and MTU. This will be optional and surfaced as a warning with remediation steps.

Installer notes and diagnostics
- Logs to check: /var/log/redwood/installer.log, /var/log/redwood/agent.log, systemd journal entries for kubelet. Use the new --trace-installer flag for verbose network traces.
- Collector: s3://internal-telemetry/private-deploys/2026-06-15/ (internal access only)
- Common grep patterns: "TCPSYN_RETRANSMISSION" , "TLS record", "nvidia-smi: permission denied"

Customer handoff checklist (current)
- [x] Initial environment questionnaire completed (network ranges, egress rules, KMS endpoints)
- [x] Signed AUP and support contract for pilot
- [x] Preflight run executed (basic checks)
- [ ] Advanced network preflight (MTU, NAT behavior) — pending GreenBank response
- [ ] HSM/KMS integration test (Acme Health requested HSM; scheduled 2026-06-22)
- [ ] Final acceptance test window scheduled with customer (RetailCo scheduled 2026-06-20)

Action items (owner — due)
- Rohit Patel — produce agent TLS-fragment hotfix PR and demo to GreenBank networking team (due 2026-06-17)
- Ethan Park — update installer preflight to detect RHEL kernel quirks and add clearer remediation text (due 2026-06-19)
- Lina Gómez — patch daemonset securityContext for GPU device plugin and publish mini runbook (due 2026-06-18)
- Maya Chen — coordinate Acme Health SOC request for encrypted audit-log forwarder; draft spec for S3-compatible forwarder (due 2026-06-23)
- Priya Nair (CS) — confirm GreenBank can run packet-capture window and share pcap (due 2026-06-16)

Notes to self (informal)
- Need a short troubleshooting script for MTU-related TLS fragmentation that SEs can run without root access on customer firewall appliances. Add to quickstart under Private Deploys.
- Consider adding a nightly e2e smoke that purposely sets MTU=1400 in CI to catch regressions early.

Open questions / risks
- If NAT port churn is widespread in certain appliance versions, we may need to negotiate a change with customers (longer NAT port persistence) or implement a stateful proxy fallback in the agent. Engineering cost estimate required.
- HSM integration: does customer expect local HSM-only key wrapping? Clarify with Acme SOC (follow-up).

Relevant links / references
- Runbook: CONFLUENCE-Private-Deploy-Runbook
- GreenBank ticket: JIRA-PLAT-2134
- Network incident trace: JIRA-OPS-4412
- Installer PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-installer/pull/128

End of notes.

-- Maya
